rules.when_to_apply: evaluating rhythm-guitar width or reference spatial matching
rules.what_to_change: choose a task-specific panel of amplitude, phase/coherence, M/S and mono checks instead of one width scalar
rules.suggested_range: no fixed numeric target; compare by frequency band and section
rules.verify: loudness-matched blind A/B plus bandwise diagnostics on verse and chorus
rules.undo_when: the metric panel disagrees with stable blind preference or encourages audible artifacts

rules.when_to_apply: an optimizer tries to lower channel correlation to create width
rules.what_to_change: treat correlation/coherence as descriptive and material-dependent, never a monotonic objective
rules.verify: blind preference and mono fold-down; inspect time-frequency cue changes
rules.undo_when: correlation is used only as a diagnostic with a validated task-specific mapping

rules.when_to_apply: decorrelation broadens sustained guitar body but blurs attacks
rules.what_to_change: compare transient-preserving or attack-bypassed decorrelation against unprotected processing
rules.suggested_range: derive detector timing from the performance; no source-backed universal milliseconds
rules.verify: matched-loudness transient A/B, envelope inspection and mono
rules.undo_when: protection causes pumping, width modulation or audible switching

rules.when_to_apply: broadband widening weakens the central low-frequency foundation
rules.what_to_change: test independent low/high-band width rather than globally narrowing the instrument
rules.suggested_range: choose crossover from inspected guitar/kick/bass overlap; no fixed frequency copied
rules.range_origin: DAFx plugin architecture; engineering test design
rules.verify: band-limited mono and stereo A/B plus full-mix blind test
rules.undo_when: the crossover creates coloration or disconnects guitar body from edge

rules.when_to_apply: selecting generated or algorithmically widened stereo
rules.what_to_change: include naturalness and overall quality alongside perceived spatialization
rules.verify: blind ratings for width, naturalness and quality as separate questions
rules.undo_when: a validated use case explicitly prioritizes an artificial spatial effect

rules.when_to_apply: validating an AI stereo reconstruction or mono-to-stereo proposal
rules.what_to_change: report Mid/Side and Left/Right spectral/phase behavior separately and add listening plus mono checks
rules.range_origin: review, DiffStereo and epsilon-ar-VAE evaluation designs
rules.verify: held-out audio, independent metrics and loudness-matched blind A/B
rules.undo_when: the system is not reconstructing or generating stereo audio

rules.when_to_apply: a learned audio representation will feed spatial or mixing decisions
rules.what_to_change: test phase-derivative and cross-channel preservation before trusting latent features
rules.suggested_range: no thresholds until a listening-calibrated project dataset exists
rules.verify: null/delta renders, ICPC/CCPC-style diagnostics and blind listening
rules.undo_when: metrics fail to predict audible damage on held-out rock material

experiments.title: independent rhythm-guitar doubles versus mono, delayed-copy baseline and band-split decorrelation
decorrelation with and without transient protection on palm-muted attacks
single correlation score versus task-specific stereo metric panel

handoff: Do not optimize one global width/correlation value. Evaluate amplitude, phase/coherence, M/S and mono by band and section. For rhythm guitars compare independent doubles with transient-protected, frequency-dependent decorrelation; judge width, naturalness and quality separately.
